host.description: URI for the Deno API. For normal use cases this value doesn't need to be set, in which case it defaults to https://api.deno.com/v1. May be set by the DENO_API_HOST environment variable.

organization_id.description: Deploy organization id. May be set by the DENO_DEPLOY_ORGANIZATION_ID environment variable. The organization id is visible in the url of the organization's project list - https://dash.deno.com/orgs/<organization_id>

token.description: Access token. May be set by the DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN environment variable. Tokens are created here: https://dash.deno.com/account#access-tokens.

block.description: The terraform provider for Deno Deploy offering management on Deno projects, custom domains, and deployments.

content.description: The inlined content of the asset. This is valid only for `file` asset. If both `content` and `content_source_path` are specified, it will error out.

content_source_path.description: The file path of the asset in the local filesystem.

encoding.description: The encoding of the inlined content. This takes effect only when `content` is present. Possible values are `utf-8` and `base64`. If omitted, the content will be interpreted as `utf-8`.

target.description: The target file path of the symlink in the the runtime virtual filesystem. It is only available for `symlink` asset.

assets.description: The entities that compose the deployment. A key represents a path to the entity.

compiler_options.description: Compiler options to be used when building the deployment. If this is omitted and a deno config file (`deno.json` or `deno.jsonc`) is found in the assets, the value in the config file will be used.

created_at.description: The time the deployment was created, formmatting in [RFC3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339).

domains.description: The domain(s) that can be used to access the deployment.

entry_point_url.description: The path to the file that will be executed when the deployment is invoked.

env_vars.description: The environment variables to be set in the runtime environment of the deployment.

import_map_url.description: The path to the import map file. If this is omitted and a deno config file (`deno.json` or `deno.jsonc`) is found in the assets, the value in the config file will be used.

lock_file_url.description: The path to the lock file. If this is omitted and a deno config file (`deno.json` or `deno.jsonc`) is found in the assets, the value in the config will be used.

project_id.description: The project ID that this deployment belongs to.

status.description: The status of the deployment, indicating whether the deployment succeeded or not. It can be "failed", "pending", or "success"

create.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

updated_at.description: The time the deployment was last updated, formmatting in [RFC3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339).

uploaded_assets.description: The assets that have been uploaded in previous deployments, keyed with hash of the content. This is inteneded to be used to avoid uploading the same assets multiple times.

block.description:
A resource for a Deno Deploy deployment.

A deployment belongs to a project, is an immutable, invokable snapshot of the project's assets, can be assigned a custom domain.

created_at.description: The time the domain was created, formmatting in [RFC3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339).

content.description: The content of the DNS record. The value depends on the type of the DNS record. For example, for `A` record, it is the IP address of the domain.

name.description: The name of the DNS record.

type.description: The type of the DNS record such as `A`, `CNAME`, etc.

dns_records.description: The DNS records that need to be added to the DNS nameserver.

token.description: The token used for verifying the ownership of the domain.

updated_at.description: The time the domain was updated, formmatting in [RFC3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339).

block.description:
A resource for a custom domain.

A custom domain is a per-organization resource, which can be associated with a deployment.
In order to associate a custom domain with a deployment, you need to verify the ownership of the domain, then prepare TLS certificates for the domain. Refer to the example below for practical usage.

domain_id.description: The ID of the domain to provision certificates for.

provisioning_status.description: The status of the certificate provisioning. Possible values are `success`, `failed`, `pending`, and `manual`.

block.description:
A resource for an automatic certificate provisioning of a custom domain.

In order to assoaicte a custom domain with a deployment, certificates needs to be ready in some way. For more information regarding the setup process, please refer to the doc of deno_domain resource.

domain_id.description: The ID of the domain to verify ownership of.

create.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

verified.description: Whether or not the domain has been verified.

block.description:
A resource for a ownership verification of a custom domain.

In order to assoaicte a custom domain with a deployment, this process must be completed. For more information regarding the setup process, please refer to the doc of deno_domain resource.

created_at.description: The time the project was created, formatted in [RFC3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339).

name.description: The name of the project. This must be globally unique, and must be between 3 and 26 characters, only contain a-z, 0-9 and -, must not start or end with a hyphen (-), and characters after hyphen (-) shouldn't be 8 or 12 in length. If not provided, a random name will be generated.

updated_at.description: The time the project was last updated, formatted in [RFC3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339).

block.description:
A resource for a Deno Deploy project.

A project consists of a collection of deployments and belongs to an organization.

content_source_path.description: The file path of the asset in the local filesystem.

kind.description: The kind of the asset. It can be either `file` or `symlink`.

target.description: The target file path of the symlink in the the runtime virtual filesystem. It is only available for `symlink` asset.

output.description: The assets map, whose key is the asset path used in the runtime virtual filesystem, and the value is the asset metadata.

path.description: The root directory path of the assets. e.g. `../dist`

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match the assets within the directory specified in `path`. e.g. `**/*.{js,ts,json}`

target.description:
The target directory path where the assets will be put in the runtime virtual filesystem.
For example, if "target" is set to "foo/bar", then the assets will be placed under the directory "foo/bar" in the runtime virtual filesystem.

If this field is omitted, the assets will be put under the "." directory in the runtime virtual filesystem.

block.description:
A data source for a list of assets to be deployed.

For how to use this data source with deno_deployment resource, please refer to the doc of deno_deployment resource.
